## Procedure and Materials 

Data collection was conducted between December 12, 2025 — January 12, 2026, using the EpicCollect5 app. The following information was recorded for each tree:

- **Surveyor Name**: Individual(s) who collected the data.
- **Location**: GPS coordinates (latitude and longitude) for mapping (Figure 10A, Figure [2](inventoryInsights.html#tree-density-map))
- **Site Name and Tree ID**: Assigned to track individual trees across sites (Figure 10B)
- **Diameter at Breast Height (DBH)**: Measured 4.4 ft above ground using a diameter tape; circumference was converted to diameter in inches (Figure 10C)
- **Tree Height**: Measured with a tangent height gauge and measuring wheel (Figure 10D)
- **X2 Spread Measurement**: Two perpendicular measurements across the widest points of the crown, measured with a measuring wheel (Figure 10E)
- **Condition**: Visually rated as Good, Fair, or Poor. (Figure 10F, Table 2)
- **Photo**: Taken for documentation. (Figure 10G)
- **Notes**: Additional observations or unusual features recorded as needed. (Figure 10H)

**Figure 10**: Screenshots of EpicCollect5 questionaries

<br/>

| Condition | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| Good      | Healthy overall appearance with no major damage; branches generally pointing upward |
| Fair      | Minor damage is present, such as small holes, minor bark issues, leaking sap, nearby thorny vegetation that may compete for resources, or partial wrapping by fuzzy roots |
| Poor      | Significant damage or decay present, including mushroom, fungi, or mold growth; hollowed trunk or branches; or the entire tree leaning noticeably in one direction |
